run_notes: HDI validation pilot. 11 relationship edges across 5 companies, plus 2 companies (Northern Dynasty Minerals, Amarc Resources) discovered through the graph that the D&B candidate list never contained — the clearest demonstration of why this is worth building. Deliberate omission: one source implied Ronald Thiessen is also President/CEO of Amarc Resources, but the wording was ambiguous and no second source confirmed it, so that edge was left out rather than asserted. All edges here are tier2_website (company management/board pages via search index) because direct fetches and SEDAR+ retrieval were both blocked in this environment — a real Phase 1 run should re-source these from management information circulars to reach tier1_filing. Expected behaviour to check: HDI and Northern Dynasty share 3 officers and should form a management group; Trekor Metals shares only DIRECTORS with the group and should therefore appear in related_companies but NOT in a management group. That asymmetry is the weighting working as designed, not a miss.
